changeSet.author: zaramoney
changeSet.comment: Ledger entries take the currency of their account
changeSet.sql: update ledger_entry l set currency = a.currency from bank_account a where a.id = l.account_id and l.currency <> a.currency;

changeSet.author: zaramoney
changeSet.comment: ledger_entry is append-only (UPDATE / DELETE / TRUNCATE rejected unless zaramoney.ledger_maintenance = on)
